newsitem.title: USA: Transcom says U.S. firm buys 9.3 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Transcom says U.S. firm buys 9.3 pct stake.

text.p: Transcom International Ltd said on Monday that Hake Capital Management of Phoenix has acquired a 9.34 percent stake of the Australia-based technology development company.
Transcom, in a news release made available in the United States, said Hake has bought 21.7 million Transcom shares.

Transcom did not provide an estimate of the size of Hake's investment, but noted that Transcom American Depositary Receipts have recently been trading in a range of 2-5/8 to 5-5/8, and each ADR represents 50 shares.
Transcom ADRs were trading up 1/16 to 2-5/8 in late Nasdaq trading.
